completion.ai: page connected and current client can call zhigao_status
completion.feishu: user login verified; target table access checked separately when supplied
completion.video: all frames and audio channels prepared; current brand basis, text, images and required audio reviewed; coverage.complete and assurance.complete true; human confirmation remains

review.context: Read each required brief.context section through nextCursor=null; reconstruct json-fragment records and block slices without truncation.
review.checkpoint: record_review_checks saves checks without completing review. Final explicit arrays replace saved arrays.
review.basisChanges: BASIS_CHANGED requires retry:true, updates pages and a fresh full review. Previous checks are advisory only.
review.sourceCache: Original parsed sources only; project and current source hashes verified; never writes derived policy to brand library.
review.resume: retry:true can restore verified checkpoints only for unchanged identity and round; use resume.restored and new context cursors. savedChecks are actual saved records, receipts alone do not establish visual review.
review.assets: read_review_assets returns 1-4 native images/audio with independent receipts; reduce batch on ASSET_BATCH_TOO_LARGE.
review.connection: Queue 90s; execution 180s, extended only by completed-work progress up to 240s; queue plus execution max 270s. Heartbeats do not extend work. Transport uncertainty never auto-reexecutes a call. A stale executing page retains ownership until completion/disconnect.
review.lease: Active work renews automatically; explicit renew_review remains available. Idle work is not renewed indefinitely.
review.compatibility: New pages advertise tools and version. Unsupported tools fail before queueing. Old pages keep legacy single-asset support; inspect installed/running/page versions separately and reload client tool discovery when idle.
review.resourceLimits: PDF canvas allocation is rejected above 40 million pixels or 32767 per dimension; no silent downscaling. This is not a total process memory limit.

brandMaterials.storage: original files; authorized folder streamed with File System Access, otherwise IndexedDB Blob; complete extracted text in IndexedDB
brandMaterials.limits: No fixed upload-byte or text-character cap; actual disk, browser quota and parser resources apply.
brandMaterials.video: Reuse video_runtime_status/setup_video_runtime, then prepare_library_assets and get_library_asset_status until complete. Read all current-brand sources and assets before review completion.
brandMaterials.unsupported: Keep originals; block complete review until converted and verified. Never treat saved as parsed.

taskPreparation.entry: Existing read/review tools automatically check prerequisites. Poll preparation.taskId; after continuation consume result.originalResult instead of repeating the original call.
taskPreparation.confirmation: Exact task, revision, environment and current user reply; configuration never authorizes business writes.
